dialogues.speaker: Matzahtli
dialogues.text: Burning biological rain... Wait, could it really be as the legends say? Volcanoes evolving and spreading like living creatures, turning everything around them into more volcanoes? Oh no, no, no! That'd be a disaster!

response.speaker: Matzahtli
response.text: Right, right. No magma, no volcano. They can't just pop up out of nowhere. If they could, this place would've been a danger zone ages ago...

response.speaker: Matzahtli
response.text: But... what if the legend is true? Ugh, if only that self-recording Kamera actually worked properly...

response.speaker: Matzahtli
response.text: Wait! What if the Kamera glitches and doesn't catch anything? That'd be a total mess! Nope, I need to go check it out myself, just to be sure...

response.speaker: Matzahtli
response.text: Okay, bye... Or wait, is there something else going on here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: B—Burning... biological... rain!? You mean the fire's gonna swoop down on our heads like it's alive? Why are Natlan's volcanoes so terrifying!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's a little curious, she's gotta admit... Hehe, why don't we go explore the area up ahead?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After inspecting the Kamera, you not only discover a set of photos of the surrounding scenery, but also a special mechanism within. It seems as if this mechanism causes the Kamera to automatically take photos whenever it detects vibrations running through the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, fire that moves like it's alive, eerie afterimages, and Kameras that can take photos automatically...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon has a hunch that there's some kind of mind-boggling mystery behind it all! Who knows, there might even be treasure involved!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Any specific reason for this hunch of yours, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: To be perfectly honest... nope! But the Kamera's owner must have put it here to capture what happens when the ground shakes...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So all we've gotta do is put the Kamera back, then wait for the ground to start quaking.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, and when that time comes... Clues to the treasure's whereabouts will no doubt come rumbling out, just like that afterimage!

dialogues.speaker: Matzahtli
dialogues.text: So, the biological fire rain is actually those Flowfire Birds falling from the sky? Ah, no wonder they cover way more ground than a normal eruption!

dialogues.speaker: Matzahtli
dialogues.text: Oh no, what if one of them crashes into my house someday? No, I gotta figure out a plan for this.

choices.text: Well, it's probably just a rare thing.

response.speaker: Matzahtli
response.text: Yeah, yeah, those Flowfire Birds only get up there because of volcanic eruptions. My house isn't anywhere near a volcano, so I'm probably fine.

response.speaker: Matzahtli
response.text: But... what if — just what if — there's some crazy, massive eruption one day? Wouldn't that mean nowhere is safe? Ugh, no, I still need to come up with a plan... just in case.

response.speaker: Matzahtli
response.text: No worries, you're not interrupting... Anyway, let's start by reinforcing the roof.
